art_direction: RoomScale category: settlement_structure. A compact, open-front Scavenger repair workshop built from recognizably reused household parts. Use an asymmetric lean-to silhouette with a patched sheet-metal roof, appliance enamel panels and drawer sections, a stable timber frame, and a visible bench and tool wall. Make the attachment of every large panel and roof edge physically understandable. Preserve an unobstructed view into the work area. Distinguish the faction through improvised reuse and mismatched construction, not a brown/rust palette alone; avoid Clockwork boilers, decorative gears, and brass trim.
